premise: Flower grows tallest in the patch and her shadow falls on Mushroom; when Snail points it out, she cannot be shorter, but she can lean, so the sun reaches everyone.
inspiration: The Oak and the Reed (La Fontaine), turned: bending is not weakness but kindness, and the tall one chooses it.
lesson: Being big comes with looking down to see who is in your shadow.

en-US.title: Flower Leans Over
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Flower {flower:pulse} was growing. Every day a little taller. {sfx:stretch} Creeeak. Taller than the grass. [excited] Look at me! she said. I can see everything! Down below, Mushroom {mushroom:pulse 0.4} said nothing. Mushroom never said much. But she was getting cold. Snail {snail:pulse} slid past and stopped. [curious] Flower, he said. Do you know what is under you? Flower looked down. Under her big yellow head was a big round shadow. And in the shadow, small and shivery, {mushroom:tint #9AD0FF} sat Mushroom. [softly] Oh, said Flower. Oh, Mushroom. I did not see. She thought. She could not be shorter. But she could… lean. {flower:wobble 0.5} Just a little. Just enough. The sun {mushroom:glow} slid onto Mushroom's cap. Thank you, whispered Mushroom. [happily] After that, Flower was still the tallest. But she leaned, a little, every day. And Butterfly {butterfly:hop} said it made her look like she was listening.

es-ES.title: Flor se inclina
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Flor {flower:pulse} estaba creciendo. Cada día un poquito más alta. {sfx:stretch} Criiic. Más alta que la hierba. [excited] ¡Miradme!, decía. ¡Lo veo todo! Abajo, Seta {mushroom:pulse 0.4} no decía nada. Seta nunca decía mucho. Pero tenía frío. Caracol {snail:pulse} pasó deslizándose y se paró. [curious] Flor, dijo. ¿Sabes qué hay debajo de ti? Flor miró hacia abajo. Bajo su gran cabeza amarilla había una sombra grande y redonda. Y en la sombra, pequeña y tiritando, {mushroom:tint #9AD0FF} estaba Seta. [softly] Oh, dijo Flor. Oh, Seta. No te había visto. Se quedó pensando. No podía hacerse más baja. Pero podía… inclinarse. {flower:wobble 0.5} Solo un poco. Lo justo. El sol {mushroom:glow} resbaló hasta el sombrero de Seta. Gracias, susurró Seta. [happily] Desde entonces, Flor siguió siendo la más alta. Pero se inclinaba, un poquito, todos los días. Y Mariposa {butterfly:hop} decía que así parecía que estaba escuchando.

stretch.prompt: a slow soft creak, like a green stem stretching and growing, gentle and a little comic
